_doc: Schema Evolution & Preservation Workflow — machine-readable slot registry. Full procedure: docs/governance/SCHEMA_EVOLUTION_CONTRACT.md. Every versioned schema in this repo is a declaration token plus a set of downstream slots; every slot is exactly one of four kinds and the kind fixes its obligation on a version bump: TRACKS_HEAD (must equal current_version), ACCUMULATES (must contain every version ever declared, never shrink), FROZEN (must never change — it records history), DERIVED (recomputed from the declaration, must match). Enforced by tests/governance/test_schema_version_registry.py. This file is NOT itself a preservation proof — STORAGE_PRESERVATION_CONTRACT.md / CANONICAL_LAYER_IDENTITY_CONTRACT.md remain authoritative for what preservation means; this registry only tracks whether a version DECLARATION has propagated to every place that depends on it.
seed_reason: F-107 (CH-schema-v6-normalization-identity) bumped feature_schema.SCHEMA_VERSION 5.0->6.0 (names-only rename, dim unchanged) but did not propagate to identity/tokens.py's ACCUMULATES vocabulary or identity/certify.py's TRACKS_HEAD emission — discovered 2026-09-18, no floor caught it because none existed. This registry + floor is the fix.

excluded_infrastructure_symbols.reason: this IS the ACCUMULATES slot for FEATURE_CANONICAL below, not an independent schema declaration — excluded from the completeness ratchet so it is not double-counted as its own unregistered schema_id.

derived.over: hashlib.md5('' .join(CANONICAL_FEATURES)) — legacy, retained for backward compat

slots.note: closed vocabulary consumed by identity/check.py's L1 IDENTITY_MISMATCH/UNIDENTIFIED logic. Must be a superset of history ∪ {current_version}; versions are ADDED, never removed — removing one orphans every archive record already written under it (§6.2 rule 4).

L1 write-time producer (certify.py is the write-time exemption from FORBIDDEN_RUNTIME_MODULES — see its own docstring and tests/test_identity_store.py::test_no_recompute_producer_imports, whose parametrize list is [check.py, store.py, query.py, outcome.py] and deliberately excludes certify.py). Enforced structurally: the emitted schema_version must come from an imported SCHEMA_VERSION name, never a hardcoded string literal, so it cannot silently go stale on the next bump.

Contract is CLOSED / FROZEN v1.0.0, user-accepted 2026-08-23 — the original '5.0 active' sentence is NOT edited in place (that would need its own §6.2 gate). Corrections land as an appended, dated CORRECTED marker per the pattern above; the floor reads the LAST such marker in the file and compares its version to current_version. See frozen_unchanged sibling slot below, which guards the original sentence stays byte-identical.

the original frozen-contract sentence itself — must remain byte-identical (§6.2 rule 4: preserve history, correct via appended note, never overwrite). This slot existing and passing is what proves the correction above was additive, not a silent rewrite of a closed contract.

TRADENET_SCHEMA / GAUSSIAN_SCHEMA inline comments. Comment-only (not machine-derived from SCHEMA_VERSION), so this is a plain text_contains check, not a python_symbol one — the dimension itself (48) is DERIVED-stable across v5.0->v6.0 since the bump was names-only, only the version label in the comment needed to move.

the six 'schema_version": "5.0"' literals in this file build a SYNTHETIC 48-dim record (NAMES is a local ['open','high','low','close', f0..f43] list, never imported from CANONICAL_FEATURES) to test IdentityStore/identity_check MECHANICS generically — they do not assert 'this is the current HEAD schema' and are deliberately left at 5.0 (still a valid, permanently-ACCUMULATES-covered token). This slot only checks that the file-top comment explaining that non-obvious decision is present, so a future reader does not mistake it for drift.

config_schema_version_note: configs/production/*.json each carry a top-level schema_version (1.3 x21, 1.2 x1, 1.0 x2, absent x1 — measured 2026-09-18) with NO code declaration site tying them together. Deliberately NOT registered as a schema_id in this pass — which version is authoritative, and whether the split is intentional per-generation tiering or drift, is an open user question (§6.2 rule 3), separate from the FEATURE_CANONICAL fix this registry seeds.
